The counterexample confirms this: `column = 1236` and `m2.Length1 = 1236`, so `column == m2.Length1`, which satisfies `column < (m2.Length1) + 1` but NOT `column < m2.Length1`.

The fix should be to change the precondition of `RowColumnProduct` from `column < (m2.Length1) + 1` to `column < m2.Length1`.
